# CapsuleProcessWithDetails

A capsule run with the names of its capsule and namespace, as a namespace's run listing returns it.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `namespaceName` | `string` | The name of the namespace the capsule is in. |
| `capsuleName` | `string` | The name of the capsule this run is of. |
| `capsule` | [`VersionReference`](version-reference.md) | The capsule and the version of it this run uses. |
| `dateStarted` | `datetime \| null` | When the run started, in UTC. Null until a worker picks it up. |
| `dateEnded` | `datetime \| null` | When the run ended, in UTC. Null while it is still going. |
| `status` | [`CapsuleProcessStatus`](capsule-process-status.md) | Where the run is in its life. |
| `failureDetails` | `string \| null` | Why the run failed, when its status is `Error`. Null otherwise. |
| `virtualFileSystemMounts` | [`CapsuleVirtualFileSystemMount`](capsule-virtual-file-system-mount.md)`[]` | The virtual file systems mounted in the run, each at `/mnt/<mountName>`. |
| `secretMounts` | [`CapsuleSecretMount`](capsule-secret-mount.md)`[]` | The secrets mounted in the run, each as the file `/mnt/secrets/<mountName>`. |
| `commands` | [`CapsuleProcessCommand`](capsule-process-command.md)`[]` | Every command and operation sent to the run, in the order they were queued, with their status and output. |
| `hostname` | `string \| null` | Identifies the worker that ran this run, for diagnostics. Null until a worker picks it up. |
| `createdUsers` | `string[]` | The Linux users created in the run so far: the capsule's own users and any added while it runs. |
| `installedPackages` | `string[]` | The Debian packages installed in the run so far: the capsule's own packages and any added while it runs. |
| `defaultUser` | `string` | The user commands run as when they don't name one: always `maitento`, never `root`. |
| `triggeredByAutomatedActionId` | `uuid \| null` | The automation that started this run (by its schedule, a message trigger or a manual trigger). Null when the run was started any other way. |
| `triggeredByAutomatedActionName` | `string \| null` | The automation's name when it started this run (a snapshot). Null exactly when `triggeredByAutomatedActionId` is. |
| `retentionLeaseActive` | `boolean \| null` | True while a retention lease keeps this run: its own, or one inherited from a retained run that started it. A retained run is never deleted when the tenant's retention period ends. Null or false: not retained. |
| `retentionLeaseAppliedAtUtc` | `datetime \| null` | When the lease was taken, in UTC. For an inherited lease, when the ancestor's lease was taken. |
| `retentionLeaseAppliedByUserId` | `uuid \| null` | The id of the user who took the lease. |
| `retentionLeaseAppliedByUserName` | `string \| null` | The name of the user who took the lease, as it was when they took it. |
| `retentionLeaseNote` | `string \| null` | Why it is retained, as the person who retained it wrote it (optional, at most 500 characters). |
| `retentionLeaseInheritedFromProcessId` | `uuid \| null` | Null when the lease is this run's own. Otherwise the id of the ancestor run whose lease keeps this one; releasing that run's lease releases this one too. |
| `parentProcessId` | `uuid \| null` | The run that started this one: an app that called `CapsuleStart`. Null for a run started directly (through the API or an automation), or when it isn't known. |
| `parentProcessType` | [`ProcessType`](process-type.md)`\| null` | What kind of run `parentProcessId` is. Null exactly when that is null. |
| `rootProcessId` | `uuid \| null` | The run at the top of this run's tree, shared by every run in it, so you can group them with one comparison. Null for a capsule run started directly, which starts no other runs. |
| `dateRunnerPing` | `datetime \| null` | When the worker running this run last reported that it is still alive, in UTC. Null before it starts. |
| `waitingForLaneSinceUtc` | `datetime \| null` | When the run started waiting for a lane, in UTC; null when it isn't waiting. A waiting run is in status New, and `GET /processes/{type}/{id}/lane` says why it waits. Set by Maitento. |
| `userCreatedById` | `uuid` | The id of the user who created it. A call made with an API key is recorded as the key's user. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |

## Where it's used

- [`capsuleRuns.listActive`](../api/capsule-runs.md) (`GET /namespaces/{namespaceName}/capsules/processes`)
